mapping: Dendritic and apical membrane-area dose to whole-cell load, measured from the stage-2 200 pA runs (the soma and axon are unchanged, so a x1.5 area dose is a 1.27x whole-cell conductance).
reading_rule: The upstroke change the human's own cable difference can explain is about 0.48 of the change the x1.5 dose produces. The human-model upstroke gap at 310 pA is 639.1 - 347.7 = 291.4 V/s.
